_note: Field names (name/description/input_schema) follow the generic tool-definition shape. Verify against the SDK create_agent example in the smoke test and adjust if the key names differ. Max 32 tools per agent, schema <= 16 KiB each.

intake.name: get_batch
intake.description: Return the items and text-only assessments for an intake batch. Each assessment contains tags, status, confidence, and reason.

intake.name: save_tags
intake.description: Save the final tags for one item. Call once per item that passed the confidence threshold or was approved by a person.

intake.name: hold_for_review
intake.description: Ask a person to decide on an item you are not confident about. This call waits until the person answers. Returns {decision: approve|edit|reject, tags?}. Use when confidence is below the threshold or label and garment disagree.

disposition.name: list_inventory
disposition.description: Return all tagged inventory rows as of the given date. Each row: item_key, category, tags{stream,fibre_type,color_group,condition}, location, season, received_date, return_window_close, item_due_date, alert_status (none|sent), status (tagged|held).

disposition.name: send_alert
disposition.description: Send one notification to the responsible person and mark the listed items as alerted. Call once per decision. Types: donate_recycle_due, review_waiting, dispute_deadline, delay_risk.

summary.description: One line, used in the subject: [TYPE] summary, deadline
